import urllib.request
url = 'http://localhost:3100/product'
variants = {
    'static_prefetch': {'RSC': '1', 'Next-Router-Prefetch': '1'},
    'full_prefetch': {'RSC': '1', 'Next-Router-Prefetch': '1', 'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch': '/_tree'},

url='http://localhost:3100/product'
tree=urllib.parse.quote('[\"\",{\"children\":[\"__PAGE__\",{}]}]',safe='')
variants={
  'default': {'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1','Next-Router-State-Tree':tree},

  'full': {'RSC':'1','Next-Router-Prefetch':'1','Next-Router-State-Tree':tree,'Next-Router-Segment-Prefetch':'/product'},
}

    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers=headers)
